title: 777-300ER Master Collection, ITA Airways Rotations & New Zealand VFR! (MSFS Marketplace Drop)
description:
Are you ready to step into heavy-metal long haulers or take a scenic low-and-slow flight across breathtaking mountain terrain in Microsoft Flight Simulator 2020? The Marketplace just delivered 12 brand new featured releases—headlined by a dedicated Boeing 777-300ER mission collection, structured European airline rotations, massive real-world hub traffic schedules, and a fully narrated VFR expedition across New Zealand!

In this structured marketplace breakdown, we dive into the details, aircraft compatibility, and operational features to help you decide what fits your flight routine and budget:

✈️ HEAVY LONG-HAUL CHALLENGES (BOEING 777-300ER MASTER COLLECTION)
Perfect Flight brings a 2-in-1 discounted master bundle combining the "777-300ER Captain Ultimate Simulation" and "777-300ER Advanced Challenges." Designed to test your command over wide-body inertia across complex global weather scenarios and high-workload arrivals. Compatible with both the PMDG 777-300ER and Captain Sim 777-300ER (note: base aircraft must be owned separately).

✈️ STRUCTURED AIRLINE NETWORK ROTATIONS (12 LEGS ITA AIRWAYS SUMMER 2026)
Step into the cockpit of the iniBuilds Airbus A320neo V2 sporting the official ITA Airways livery for a comprehensive 12-leg network rotation across Italy. Operating round-trip out of Rome Fiumicino (LIRF), this package guides you through authentic line flights connecting Milan, Palermo, Trieste, Bologna, Lamezia Terme, and more. Features authentic aviation audio, over 100 monitored flight events, custom flight plans, and external tool compatibility.

🌐 GLOBAL AIRLINE FLEETS & INTERNATIONAL HUB OVERHAULS (VA SYSTEMS)
Looking to inject real-world airline schedules and authentic liveries into your simulator? VA Systems introduces targeted summer schedule packages for carriers including Aeroméxico, Air North, Malaysia Airlines, Middle East Airlines (MEA), and Pegasus Airlines. In addition, major international gateway hub packs arrive for Tokyo Haneda (RJTT), Brussels (EBBR), Houston George Bush (KIAH), Murtala Muhammed (DNMM), and Brasília (SBBR)—adding authentic departures, arrival banks, and airline liveries across major commercial hubs.

🇳🇿 SCENIC EXPEDITIONS (GUIDED TOURS: NEW ZEALAND VFR)
Transform your cockpit into a front-row seat to one of the most geographically diverse landscapes on Earth. Perfect Flight takes you across both the North and South Islands of New Zealand in a 12-stage guided touring expedition featuring over 350 narrated historical and geographical waypoints, optimized flight profiles, and custom airport approach procedures.

Whether you're cruising across continents in the Triple Seven, managing regional turns through the Italian peninsula, or following narrated visual waypoints through New Zealand's fjords, these additions deliver structured real-world goals for your flight sessions.

Which of these releases are you loading into your flight computer first? Let us know in the comments below!

If you find these marketplace breakdowns helpful, don't forget to hit the like button, subscribe for weekly flight sim coverage, and clear skies on your next flight!
